introHtml: Hand wash only speakers are designed for environments where gentle cleaning is necessary, such as trade show giveaways or office wellness kits. Unlike standard speakers that may warp in dishwashers, these durable units maintain sound quality with simple hand washing. Ideal for promotional gifts that see frequent handling, they allow your logo to stay visible wash after wash. Pair them with a microfiber cloth for a complete branded cleaning set.
